findings.question: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)? yes = In operation and serving government workloads; partial = Announced or in pilot; no = A source states none exists

findings.value: yes
findings.title: Polo Strategico Nazionale: il cloud sovrano per l'Italia digitale
findings.publisher: Polo Strategico Nazionale S.p.A.
findings.note: PSN runs government workloads today. Per its own pages it is owned by TIM, Leonardo, CDP Equity and Sogei, with sites at Acilia, Pomezia, Rozzano and Santo Stefano Ticino; its homepage reports central administrations rising from 120 to 576. It also sells a 'Hybrid Cloud on PSN Site' based on Microsoft Azure, which is relevant to the foreign-dependency assessment.

review.established: yes
review.reason: The Polo Strategico Nazionale site states in the present tense that it manages PA data and services in 4 national data centres, which shows it is in operation.
